errors.description: The final characterization is not valid without restricting primes to those occurring initially: for any absent prime, every positive exponent divides all zero valuations, so arbitrarily many new prime factors can be added and no maximal d exists.
errors.quote: the unique maximal $d$ with $v_p(d) \mid v_p(a_i)$ for all $p$ and all $i$

parsed.notes: The actual proof is complete and correct. Termination follows from the product/number-of-ones potential, and the prime-wise gcd invariant uniquely determines the terminal value. The inaccurate optional remark does not affect either part.
